name: Bakersfield
housing: Bakersfield renters mostly live in single-family houses and apartment complexes, with older homes and duplexes near downtown and east Bakersfield.

tenantHelp.name: Greater Bakersfield Legal Assistance
tenantHelp.what: free legal help and the city's eviction prevention program

climate: Summer highs often top 100°F, so test the air conditioning, check window screens and seals, and note any dust getting in.
fact: The City of Bakersfield funds an eviction prevention program run by Greater Bakersfield Legal Assistance.
